body: The hop is the single-stage weighted walk in FightMoves.select: role_weights are set correctly by _role_weights() but each role's weight is spread across its technique-region pair count, so a role with 15 pairs at weight 3.0 is outvoted by a role with 2 pairs at weight 1.0. Two-stage selection (ROLE_PRIORITY_FROM_PLAN, default OFF) fixes it: counter(w=3.0) went from 3-27% to 35-67% across plans. Setup ceiling: boxing=9, KB=13, MT=18, MMA=22 (but mma_jab_levelchange is a grapple entry, not a strike).
